notes.nominal_percent: Stored weights per selection roll, out of 100. This excludes the random generator's modulo bias.
notes.fish_spawn: Probability of the fish kind being spawned for a fish roll. Catch rates depend on fishing behavior and bait.
notes.null_item_id: The table selected no item or no fish.
notes.area_index: Zero-based engine slot in the map's stage list.
notes.spot_index: Zero-based within the area. Fish spots have their own sequence.
notes.scope: Checksum-valid quests in this DATA.BIN. Does not include Pokke Farm facilities or quests supplied separately from the archive.
